questions.question: Dahan Enheartened at Terror II or III gives each player Gather and Damage instructions in their chosen land. Players A and B each choose to Gather one Dahan. May A Gather, then B Gather, then both deal their Damage, or must one player finish that player's full instructions before the next begins?

After a primary action and all triggered actions finish, an Invader is still illegally placed. Do players check victory/defeat with that illegal position first, or correct its position before that check? Assume a legal destination exists.

Thunderspeaker has met both a threshold making one of its Innates Fast and a threshold that can affect game state. Is the Speed-changing threshold applied only at its printed position after the lower effects, or before checking the phase in which that Innate can be used?

Bringer has used Vengeance of the Dead in a land. A later action by another Spirit actually destroys a Town there, causing Bringer's Vengeance to trigger. Is the triggered Damage real because the other Spirit caused the trigger, or does it still follow To Dream a Thousand Deaths?

A populated land matches both the Ravage card and the Build card this turn. A Spread of Rampant Green has three Presence in that land and uses Choke the Land with Green to skip its Ravage, destroying one of those Presence. No other effect changes the land before Build. Does that payment also skip the later Build, or must Green choose again and destroy another of its Presence there? Is the remaining Sacred Site sufficient for that second use?

A Ravage destroys a Dahan. Thunderspeaker has no Presence in the ravaged land but has its own Presence in an adjacent land. Can Sworn to Victory require destruction of that nearby Presence, or is the rule confined to Presence in the ravaged land?

The Trees and Stones Speak of War has created its per-Dahan Defend in a land also benefiting from Words of Warning's separate Defend 3. Trees and Stones meets its threshold and Pushes one Dahan out. Does that Dahan carry the separate Defend 3 too, or only its own Defend 2 from Trees and Stones?
A copy of the core game contains 14 Presence disks of one color. Should all 14 be used for that Spirit's setup and later Presence availability, or is one a spare?

In standard one-Spirit solo, are any of the eight original-core Spirits prohibited because their special restrictions appear to require teammates, including Ocean's Hungry Grasp or Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares?

answer_key.answer: One player finishes that player's entire Fear instruction sequence, including its Damage, before the next player starts. They may choose which player goes first, but may not interleave Gather and Damage between players.

answer_key.answer: The first payment skips only the Ravage. For the later Build, Green makes a fresh optional choice and must destroy another of its own Presence in that land to skip it. Two Presence remain before that choice, so Green still has the required Sacred Site and may pay the second cost, ending with one Presence. Destroying the first Presence did not create a turn-long skip.

asked_fact_entries.question: Dahan Enheartened at Terror II or III gives each player Gather and Damage instructions in their chosen land. Players A and B each choose to Gather one Dahan. May A Gather, then B Gather, then both deal their Damage, or must one player finish that player's full instructions before the next begins?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May the two players interleave Gather and Damage?
required_facts: One player must finish the full Gather-and-Damage instruction sequence before the next starts; the proposed interleaving is not allowed.

key_context_not_required.fact: Players choose which player goes first.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks interleaving, not player-order selection.

asked_fact_entries.question: After a primary action and all triggered actions finish, an Invader is still illegally placed. Do players check victory/defeat with that illegal position first, or correct its position before that check? Assume a legal destination exists.

required_facts: Correct the illegal position after the completed action tree but before checking victory/defeat; check the cleaned-up state.

key_context_not_required.fact: The normal cleanup uses the nearest legal land and is not an action.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Those are directly asked in Q81, not separately requested by this ordering question; a legal destination is stipulated.

asked_fact_entries.question: Thunderspeaker has met both a threshold making one of its Innates Fast and a threshold that can affect game state. Is the Speed-changing threshold applied only at its printed position after the lower effects, or before checking the phase in which that Innate can be used?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When the Fast threshold is applied
required_facts: Apply the Speed-changing threshold when checking the Innate's Speed/phase, before its ordinary effects rather than postponing it until its printed position.

key_context_not_required.fact: The met Fast threshold allows Fast use in this case.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: This follows directly from applying the stipulated threshold at the phase check; do not require another recital of the given threshold or Elements.

key_context_not_required.fact: Later Elements cannot retroactively legalize earlier targets or phases.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The refined question omits this already-tested Q27 subject.

asked_fact_entries.question: Bringer has used Vengeance of the Dead in a land. A later action by another Spirit actually destroys a Town there, causing Bringer's Vengeance to trigger. Is the triggered Damage real because the other Spirit caused the trigger, or does it still follow To Dream a Thousand Deaths?

required_facts: The delayed trigger remains Bringer's Power, follows To Dream a Thousand Deaths and deals hypothetical rather than real Damage; the other Spirit causing the trigger does not take ownership.

key_context_not_required.fact: Qualifying hypothetical destruction produces the usual nightmare Fear/Push.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks whether the triggered effect remains Bringer's Power; it does not request Fear values or a separate piece-type list.

asked_fact_entries.question: A populated land matches both the Ravage card and the Build card this turn. A Spread of Rampant Green has three Presence in that land and uses Choke the Land with Green to skip its Ravage, destroying one of those Presence. No other effect changes the land before Build. Does that payment also skip the later Build, or must Green choose again and destroy another of its Presence there? Is the remaining Sacred Site sufficient for that second use?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does the Ravage payment cover the later Build?
required_facts: No; the first payment skips only the Ravage, not the later Build.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Decision and cost for the later Build
required_facts: Skipping the later Build requires a fresh optional choice and another of Green's Presence destroyed in that land.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Is the remaining Sacred Site sufficient?
required_facts: Yes; the Presence remaining before Build still forms the required Sacred Site for the second use.

key_context_not_required.fact: Two disks remain before the Build choice and one after a second payment.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks whether the site suffices and whether a new payment is required; an equivalent correct response need not independently recite every intermediate/final count.

key_context_not_required.fact: The original two-Build proposal lacked a verified base producer.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Scope provenance, not an answer requirement. The frozen question instead uses normal Ravage then Build.

asked_fact_entries.question: A Ravage destroys a Dahan. Thunderspeaker has no Presence in the ravaged land but has its own Presence in an adjacent land. Can Sworn to Victory require destruction of that nearby Presence, or is the rule confined to Presence in the ravaged land?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May adjacent own Presence be lost?
required_facts: Yes; Sworn to Victory can require Thunderspeaker's adjacent Presence, rather than being confined to the ravaged land.

key_context_not_required.fact: The general footprint is Range 1 and the loss is per Dahan after the whole Ravage.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt tests the given adjacent-Presence case; general timing and multiplier are not separate requests here. Q76 directly asks the timing/case loss.

asked_fact_entries.question: The Trees and Stones Speak of War has created its per-Dahan Defend in a land also benefiting from Words of Warning's separate Defend 3. Trees and Stones meets its threshold and Pushes one Dahan out. Does that Dahan carry the separate Defend 3 too, or only its own Defend 2 from Trees and Stones?

required_facts: Only the fixed Trees and Stones Defend 2 travels with that Dahan; Words of Warning's separate Defend 3 does not travel.

key_context_not_required.fact: The separate Defend remains in the original land alongside the retained Trees Defend.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks what travels, rather than requiring another independent description of all effects remaining behind.

key_context_not_required.fact: Words of Warning's attack-timing effect also does not become a traveling effect.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks Defend, not attack timing.

asked_fact_entries.question: A copy of the core game contains 14 Presence disks of one color. Should all 14 be used for that Spirit's setup and later Presence availability, or is one a spare?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Use all 14 or treat one as spare?
required_facts: Use 13 Presence of that color; the extra disk is a spare and is not available for setup or later gameplay.

asked_fact_entries.question: In standard one-Spirit solo, are any of the eight original-core Spirits prohibited because their special restrictions appear to require teammates, including Ocean's Hungry Grasp or Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Any original Spirits prohibited in one-Spirit solo?
required_facts: None are prohibited: all eight original-core Spirits are permitted in solo, including the named Ocean and Bringer.

key_context_not_required.fact: The FAQ also says solo wins are possible with each Spirit, without guaranteeing every play state.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks selection legality, not strategy, winnability proofs or a guarantee.

key_context_not_required.fact: Use ordinary solo targeting and each Spirit's normal restrictions.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Those are already separately tested; no extra recital is requested here.
